Product Overview

The Europull Spark Proof Lever Hoist offers supreme safety when tensioning pipelines, pulling heavy structural sections, or aligning machinery in hazardous hydrocarbon processing areas.

Frequently Asked Questions

Which models of the Europull Spark Proof Lever Hoist are available?

The Europull Spark Proof Lever Hoist is available in 4 models: EPC-LEX075, EPC-LEX150, EPC-LEX300, EPC-LEX600. Capacity (Tons) ranges from 0.75 Ton to 6.0 Ton. Full figures for every model are in the technical specifications table on this page.

What capacity range does the Europull Spark Proof Lever Hoist cover?

The Europull Spark Proof Lever Hoist covers 0.75t - 6t.

Which standard does the Europull Spark Proof Lever Hoist comply with?

The Europull Spark Proof Lever Hoist is manufactured to ATEX / EN 13157.

What aTEX Classification does the Europull Spark Proof Lever Hoist have?

The Europull Spark Proof Lever Hoist's aTEX Classification: ATEX Ex II 2GD c IIB T4 / Non-Sparking.

What hook & Parts does the Europull Spark Proof Lever Hoist have?

The Europull Spark Proof Lever Hoist's hook & Parts: Solid Copper Beryllium / Bronze Non-Sparking Alloys.

What brake System does the Europull Spark Proof Lever Hoist have?

The Europull Spark Proof Lever Hoist's brake System: Weston Style Dual-Pawl Enclosed Spark-Safe Brake.
